actual_Main_read_full11_substantive_find.Main_finding: Viewed all three original author integer-nearest analysis sheets: 8 source item icons plus two original 64x64 wear atlases, and all 15 Wildwood/13 Sylvan raw UV-size nets. These are source analysis sheets, not native wearing screenshots or newly made art.
actual_Main_read_full11_substantive_find.author_confirmation: 确认源分析页的查看范围，不称新稿或实机。

actual_Main_read_full11_substantive_find.Main_finding: Wildwood: orange-brown branches, a long central face slat, dark/transparent eye-mouth gaps, paired broad chest slats and detached shoulder knots; transverse shin joints and two block feet. Yellow wood highlights and dark end/gap blocks serve wood material; no humanoid illustration. Do not copy fine grain into Dynasty target pixels.
actual_Main_read_full11_substantive_find.author_confirmation: 确认木条/间隙/宽胸板/分离肩结/胫横节的整体材质；不复制细木纹。

actual_Main_read_full11_substantive_find.Main_finding: Sylvan: broad warm off-white plates over green cloth at forehead/boot cuffs, brown branch fasteners, blue-white/red-yellow/purple-green small chest flower clusters. Light shin panels differ from wood joints. Dense grey atlas checker grain and elaborate leaf/branch head silhouette do not become ordinary Dynasty armor proportions.
actual_Main_read_full11_substantive_find.author_confirmation: 确认浅板绿布与小花焦点；枝叶头冠和棋格纹作为谨慎反例。

actual_Main_read_full11_substantive_find.Main_finding: Each family has four actual native registry slots and eight complete generated item JSONs collectively. Item layer0 is roots:items/<ID> (plural items), separate from dedicated 64x64 wear atlas. Per-slot cached model selection rejects non-ARMOR. No inferred vanilla layer1/layer2 contract.
actual_Main_read_full11_substantive_find.author_confirmation: 确认8原生槽与plural items路径，专用64x64图不套标准L1L2。

actual_Main_read_full11_substantive_find.Main_finding: All 60+53 source box declarations, parent addChild, origins, sizes, literal pivots, radian rotations and UV bounds match saved correspondence. Model mirror=true occurs after addBox; final field is not proof of baked mirroring because exact ModelBox construction consumer remains unread.
actual_Main_read_full11_substantive_find.author_confirmation: 确认113盒及父子姿态记录；addBox后mirror字段不证明已烘焙镜像。

actual_Main_read_full11_substantive_find.Main_finding: Wildwood applies chest childY-1, leg/boot childY-12 and armorScale1.2. Sylvan applies head childY+1, leg/boot childY-12 and armorScale1.1. Initial rootY-12 is not final world position; base render follows biped poses and applies later scale/translation.
actual_Main_read_full11_substantive_find.author_confirmation: 确认childY/armorScale只是局部变换，初始-12不称最终世界坐标。

actual_Main_read_full11_substantive_find.Main_finding: Full fixed-upstream ModelArmorBase creates eight 64x64 roots, chooses HEAD/head; CHEST/chest+arms; LEGS/legs; FEET/boots. Adult render separately scales torso/limbs and translates lower roots. Child path in this bounded source does not call renderArms; this is not a reproduced current bug or authorization to change production.
actual_Main_read_full11_substantive_find.author_confirmation: 确认8根分槽和成年变换；儿童无renderArms仅有界源码观察，不改当前程序。

actual_Main_read_full11_substantive_find.Main_finding: Subclass public slot shadows base slot but base constructor stores passed slot used by base render. Ordinary angles delegate biped; ArmorStand angles convert degrees to radians. Exact runtime dependency and game version consumer differ from current Dynasty.
actual_Main_read_full11_substantive_find.author_confirmation: 确认slot遮蔽不否定base已保存传参；ArmorStand角度转换与当前运行分开。

actual_Main_read_full11_substantive_find.Main_finding: Registration chain bounded read: RegistryManager content event calls ModItems init; eight native item registrations; LibRegistry shared initAll posts RegisterContentEvent then registers items and invokes IModeledObject.initModel on model event. handler ModelResourceLocation resolver not read/executed.
actual_Main_read_full11_substantive_find.author_confirmation: 确认内容事件/列表注册/IModeledObject链的已读范围；MRL解析仍未闭合。

actual_Main_read_full11_substantive_find.Main_finding: Compared full saved observations of six existing skull/feather harness, forest-troll hide, ironwood-rivet, leaf headgear, steeleaf plate, and partial wooden chest/leg groups. These are saved textual judgments only, not new raw pixel/source reviews or exhaustive novelty. Two related branch-and-panel sets conservatively form at most ONE complete learning mechanism; slots, cubes, source files and raw nets add zero.
actual_Main_read_full11_substantive_find.author_confirmation: 确认只复用6组完整文字观察，不冒充旧像素重读；两相关套最多一族，组件零信用。

actual_Main_read_full11_substantive_find.Main_finding: Potential application: bamboo/wood armor may learn branch fastener versus broad panel material separation while retaining vanilla block silhouette and discrete large pixel shading. Current target summary is not evidence all seven family original assets were freshly inspected, redrawn or authorized for overwrite.
actual_Main_read_full11_substantive_find.author_confirmation: 确认竹木目标只能借材料分区，7目标摘要不当原稿重审或覆盖授权。
